course.a: No. Shortlisted is a placement program — like having your own placement cell. There are no classes or syllabus.

batch.a: After you subscribe, you are automatically assigned to the current open batch (max 12 students). A coordinator is assigned to guide your batch.

jobs.a: Jobs are posted on the DISHA platform by companies. DISHA admins assign relevant jobs to your Shortlisted batch.

refund.a: Subscription terms are shared at checkout. Contact support for exceptional cases.
